name: Pygame
description: Pygame is a Python library for writing games, built on top of SDL. Pete Shinners started it in 2000 to replace the stalled PySDL project, and it became a standard first step for people learning game programming. Batocera's pygame system runs Python games written with it.

specs.maker: Pete Shinners and the pygame community

curiosities: Development stalled from 2009 until late 2016, and Pygame 2.0 came out on its 20th anniversary, 28 October 2020.
The rhythm game Frets on Fire was written with Pygame.
A group of former core developers forked the project as pygame-ce (Community Edition) in 2023.
Pygame 2 moved from SDL 1.2 to SDL2.
